name: io.github.edsml-jz2321/quotemem
title: QuoteMem
description: Auditable long-term memory for agents: source quotes, versioned updates and confirmed forgetting.

runtimeArguments.name: -y
runtimeArguments.description: Run the package without a prompt.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEMEM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the QuoteMem memory service.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEMEM_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: A file that holds only the service's token. Leave it unset for a service on this computer: the server then reads that service's token itself.

environmentVariables.name: QUOTEMEM_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Whose memory the tools read and write. Default: your OS user name.
